description: Short squeeze score and long flush score, 0-100, for any Hyperliquid perp. Composite of Hyperliquid funding (35), whale crowding (25: the net-long share of the top 250 Hyperliquid accounts in the coin, not retail), the 24h open-interest build from our own 5-minute sampler (20) and liquidation skew from our own tape (20). One number for whether a trade is crowded and about to hurt someone. A symbol nothing lists answers 400; while the open-interest record is under 24 hours deep, or Hyperliquid or the whale snapshot is unavailable, it answers 503; both are never billed. A listed coin none of the top 250 accounts holds returns 200 with a decline naming the missing input. Costs 0.1 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
